args.command:
br create --title "Implement sanitizer pipeline latency measurement" --description "Implement the actual benchmark logic that measures sanitizer pipeline performance.

## Deliverables
- Implement benchmark function that runs the full sanitizer pipeline on generated test data
- Pipeline includes: keyword pre-filter (Aho-Corasick) → regex → entropy check
- Measure and report throughput (ops/sec) and latency (per-iteration time)
- Ensure the benchmark uses the actual sanitizer code from src/, not a mock

## Dependencies
- Depends on bf-2my (scaffold and test data generation must exist first)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Benchmark calls real sanitizer pipeline code
- [ ] Criterion reports latency and throughput metrics
- [ ] Benchmark completes successfully for all three size categories (10KB, 100KB, 1MB)
- [ ] cargo bench --bench sanitize shows meaningful measurements" --label split-child

args.command:
br create --title "Add assertion-style test with configurable threshold" --description "Add an assertion-style test that fails if sanitization is too slow, with configurable threshold.

## Deliverables
- Add test function in benches/sanitize.rs (or tests/ if more appropriate) that:
  - Runs sanitization on a 100KB trace sample multiple times
  - Measures median latency
  - Fails the test if median exceeds threshold (default 10ms)
- Make threshold configurable via environment variable (e.g., SANITIZE_THRESHOLD_MS)
- Default threshold: 10ms
- Test should run in normal cargo test (not just cargo bench)

## Dependencies
- Depends on bf-13c (needs working latency measurement code)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test exists and is runnable via cargo test
- [ ] Test fails if median latency exceeds threshold
- [ ] SANITIZE_THRESHOLD_MS environment variable overrides default
- [ ] Test passes with default 10ms threshold on modern hardware" --label split-child
